Company Release - 11/09/2026 CACI Named 'Contractor of the Year' at 2026 Greater Washington Government Contractor Awards


RESTON, Va.


, Nov. 9, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) has been named Contractor of the Year by the Northern Virginia Chamber (NVC) and the Professional Services Council (PSC) at the 2026 Greater Washington Government Contractor Awards. The recognition, presented in the category for companies with more than $300 million in annual revenue, honors distinguished financial and operational accomplishments and outstanding contributions to employees, the government contracting industry, and the U.S. government.


"This award recognizes the exceptional performance of our 27,000-plus employees and their unwavering commitment to our customers," said[John Mengucci, CACI President and Chief Executive Officer](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816794-1&h=1945545732&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.caci.com%2Fbio%2Fjohn-s-mengucci&a=John+Mengucci%2C+CACI+President+and+Chief+Executive+Officer) . "Their talent, and dedication have made CACI one of the industry's leading technology-first national security companies. I'm incredibly proud of what we've accomplished and the impact we're making on our nation's most important missions."


CACI earned the recognition following a year of exceptional business performance. In 2025, the company generated nearly $9 billion in revenue, representing 10.4% year-over-year growth, and secured $11.6 billion in contract awards. These results reflect CACI's continued growth, disciplined execution, and success in delivering advanced technologies that address the nation's most critical security challenges.


CACI's selection as Contractor of the Year follows John Mengucci's recognition as Executive of the Year at the 2025 Greater Washington Government Contractor Awards, marking consecutive years of recognition for the company's leadership and performance.


**About CACI** CACI International Inc (NYSE: CACI) is a technology-first national security company that expands the limits of national security through innovation, discipline, and operational excellence. We deliver advanced technologies that help our customers move faster, operate more efficiently, and anticipate and defeat evolving threats. Our 27,000 talented employees and strong culture drive our success and have earned CACI recognition as a Fortune World's Most Admired Company. CACI is a member of the Fortune 500™, the Russell 1000 Index, and the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, visit caci.com.
